newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hai Xing advises caution on its shares.
newsitem.headline: Hai Xing advises caution on its shares.

text.p: Shanghai Hai Xing Shipping Co Ltd on Monday advised investors to exercise caution in dealing in its shares because it had yet to learn how the company would be affected by the setting up of the China Shipping Group.
"The board of directors cannot determine whether the recent price and volume increases are due to the above proposal by the Ministry of Communciations," the company said in a statement.
"Further details regarding the reorgainsation and the role of China Shipping Group are being discussed at the Ministry of Communications," it said.

Shanghai Hai Xing said the Ministry of Communications was proposing to establish a holding company to be named China Shipping Group in which its 56.45 percent controlling shareholder, Shanghai Shipping (Group) Co, would be a member.

The other two members in the China Shipping Group would include Guangzhou Shipping (Group) Co and Dalian Shipping (Group) Co, which are state-owned enterprises under the direct supervision of the ministry involved in shipping operations in southern China and the Bohai Bay region respectively.
Shares of Shanghai Hai Xing, which rose HK$0.31 or 36 percent last week, fell HK$0.03 to HK$1.14 early Monday.
